subject: Furnix Supplies — W-9, PO routing and supplier onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@furnix-supplies.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Furnix Supplies — onboarding info and PO routing question

Hi Linda,

Thanks for taking the time on the call today — great to get Furnix in our supplier queue. To move vendor setup forward, procurement needs the following items so Finance can create the vendor record and route POs correctly: 

- Legal entity name (as it appears on tax filings) and any DBAs
- Completed supplier onboarding CSV (attached) with primary AP contact and preferred PO email
- Completed and signed W-9 (or W-8 if applicable)
- ACH details or remit instructions for US payments (bank name, routing/account or payment portal)
- Primary invoice format: email, portal, or EDI (sample PO routing formats welcome)

I attached our Furnix_Supplier_Onboarding_Form.csv — please fill the highlighted fields and return with the signed W-9. If you prefer, I can open a DocuSign envelope for the vendor agreement; I included a sample PO routing example in case your AP prefers XML/EDI.

Next steps: once we have the legal name + W-9, Finance (Kim) will provision the vendor record. We typically create the vendor in our ERP within 2 business days and share the vendor ID so procurement can tag the first PO.

Would you be able to return the completed CSV and W-9 by EOD Tuesday (5/4)? If any of the bank details are sensitive, feel free to send them directly to accounts.payable@furnix-supplies.com with me on CC.

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Linda Park <linda.park@furnix-supplies.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:26:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Furnix Supplies — onboarding info and PO routing question

Hi Alex,

Thanks — attached is our signed W-9 (Furnix_W9_signed.pdf) and the onboarding CSV populated with our AP and remittance details. A couple notes:

- Legal entity: Furnix Holdings, Inc. (DBA Furnix Supplies)
- AP contact: Jessica Lim (ap@furnix-supplies.com, +1 415 555 0123)
- Preferred invoice method: Invoice email + PDF (ap@furnix-supplies.com); we can also accept EDI for high-volume POs
- Bank details: we prefer ACH; sensitive details present in the attached CSV under secure column

I have copied accounts.payable@furnix-supplies.com in case Finance needs direct verification. We do not currently have a vendor ID on your side, so will wait for your confirmation before we acknowledge any POs.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood requires a separate vendor agreement signature, or if the W-9 + onboarding form is sufficient to provision the record?

Best,
Linda

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:05:30 -0700
Subject: Furnix — vendor creation request (needs Finance action)

Kimberly / Marissa,

FYI — Furnix returned the populated onboarding CSV and a signed W-9 (attached). Key vendor details below for vendor-record creation:

- Legal name: Furnix Holdings, Inc.
- DBA: Furnix Supplies
- Tax ID/EIN: 27-3456789 (on attached W-9)
- AP email: ap@furnix-supplies.com; primary contact Jessica Lim
- Preferred remit: ACH (bank details in secure CSV)
- Invoicing: email PDF preferred; will accept EDI for volume POs

Can Finance provision a vendor with a remit-to of Furnix Holdings, Inc. and tag Furnix Supplies as the DBA? Also would like a vendor flag for EDI-capable so procurement can route test POs properly.

If you need any additional paperwork (vendor agreement), I can initiate the DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC1234-FURNIX

Thanks — Alex
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:14:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Furnix — vendor creation request (needs Finance action)

Alex — thanks for the summary. I reviewed the W-9 and the EIN matches the legal name. Finance will provision the vendor record this morning. Action items we will take: 

1) Create vendor master record: Vendor ID FUR-4721 (attached as FURNIX_vendor_record_FUR-4721.pdf)
2) Set remit-to and add DBA field as requested
3) Flag record EDI-capable and add ap@furnix-supplies.com as primary invoice route
4) Set internal PO routing rule to send a copy to procurement mailbox for the first two POs for verification

Question: do we want to require a signed Redwood vendor agreement before issuing the first PO, or is the W-9 + onboarding form sufficient? My preference is to issue a test PO and hold payment until a signed agreement is on file if legal insists.

I'll proceed with provisioning and will publish the vendor ID once complete.

—Kim
From: accounts.payable@furnix-supplies.com <accounts.payable@furnix-supplies.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 May 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Furnix vendor provisioning confirmed — PO routing details

Hi Alex / Kim,

Thanks for provisioning FUR-4721. We confirm the remit and AP details are correct. A quick note on routing: Furnix can accept emailed POs at ap@furnix-supplies.com. For EDI testing we can accept a sample via sftp or can onboard via your EDI gateway — our EDI contact is edionboarding@furnix-supplies.com.

We received your sample PO route and will confirm acceptance once a test PO is sent. Please let us know if Redwood requires a signed vendor agreement prior to acknowledging the first PO; otherwise we will accept a test PO for validation and hold payment until the agreement is returned should Legal require it.

Best regards,
Furnix Accounts Payable
